latest_release.name: Firecracker v1.18.0
latest_release.body:
## Added

- [#6393](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6393): Added  support for Nitro Sandboxes. Firecracker can now launch and manage isolated VMs that the Nitro Hypervisor carves out of the parent EC2 instance, as an alternative to KVM. Firecracker drives the Nitro Enclaves driver (`/dev/nitro_enclaves`) instead of `/dev/kvm`, and keeps its existing API, jailer and virtio device model. A sandbox is configured with the new `PUT /enclave` API, in confidential or direct mode. See the [Nitro Sandboxes documentation](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/blob/firecracker-v1.18/docs/nitro-sandboxes/README.md).
